verses.1: Rani Akra did not give birth to any children. Her children were not healthy either. For many of the children of Shomma, and also those of Beulah, Jehovah said:
verses.2: I will expand the place where I dwell. The curtains of your dwellings will be torn apart. Do not worry about me; I will continue to live among you.
verses.3: For right and left will be divided, and your descendants will inherit nations. And cities will be taken away by the dead.
verses.4: Do not be afraid, for I will not harm you. Do not despair, for I will not fail you. For in your darkness, I will forget your shame and disgrace. I will never remember them anymore.
verses.5: For your husband, O Israel, is the name of the Lord’s army; and your king is holy, the God of all the earth. He will surely speak to you.
verses.6: For a woman has been left behind, and her sorrow is like the crying of a child. Oh LORD, hear her cries! For she is like a young girl who has been left alone.
verses.7: In that brief moment, you left me; but with great mercy, I will catch you again.
verses.8: In that moment of darkness, I hid my face from you for a moment. But in your kindness, you showed me your mercy. “Go away, LORD!” said I.
verses.9: For this is what God has done for me: He has blessed me even after I had passed through the waters of Noah’s ark. So also, He will bless me from above you, and from among your people.
verses.10: For the mountains will be destroyed, and the hills will be leveled. But Your kindness will not be destroyed. And Your covenant will not be broken. May You have mercy, O LORD!
verses.11: It’s a terrible storm that won’t stop. Now, I am in the midst of these rocks and stones; you have built me up into a pile of ruins.
verses.12: And I have set up your sun and your moon as pillars of stone; and all your boundaries are like pillars of iron.
verses.13: And all your children shall be obedient to the LORD, and they will be full of joy.
verses.14: In righteousness, you will keep me away from evil. For I will not be afraid of it, and I will not approach it at all.
verses.15: May Ghor Yagur Eps be removed from me. May no one touch you on your head.
verses.16: See, I created a tool that can be used to burn coal in fire. I also created something that can be used for destruction.
verses.17: All your plans will fail against you. All your schemes will be defeated by my judgment. This is the inheritance of the servants of Yahweh. May their righteousness be from me, says Yahweh.
